methodology.evaluation_filter: accuracy includes only instances where at least one Haiku or Fable solver-agent rollout matched the oracle

combined.definition: calibrated difficulty: 10 * (1 - expected success), expected success = calibrated mean of partial credit and exact-match rate

fitted_to.definition: 0.5 * mean partial-credit score + 0.5 * exact-match rate across scopes; unanswered = 0

methodology.binning: four levels at the 25%/50%/75% score quantiles within answer_archetype (repository navigation: none; combined: none): easy, medium, hard, very_hard; evaluation outcomes are joined only after bins are frozen

frozen_thresholds.frozen_from: out/lark/run_20260812_203539/difficulty_report.json (pooled thresholds shared by the 12 runs committed in git HEAD c77612d)
